description: This Perl script generates tab-completion files for different shells (zsh and fish) for the 'curl' command. It parses the output of 'curl --help' and structures completion options accordingly.

methods.name: parse_main_opts
methods.description: Parses command-line options using regex patterns and constructs completion options for shells.

methods.name: call_curl
methods.description: Executes the curl command with specified options and captures its output.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: strip_dash
methods.description: Removes leading dashes from option strings.

search-terms: Perl script for curl shell completion
